title: Sin doesn’t destroy people overnight.
paragraphs:
Sin doesn’t destroy people overnight.
It destroys them slowly… while they ignore it.
James 1:15 says sin brings forth death.

The real danger isn’t just sin.
It’s pretending it’s not a problem.
Most people don’t fall because of one big sin.
They fall because of the sin they keep excusing.

Ignoring sin doesn’t make it disappear.
It just gives it time to grow.
God forgives — but we still have to face it.
Do you think ignoring sin is one of the biggest spiritual dangers today?
